title: Practice 6: в- and вы-: in, and out

blocks.text: Exercises: sentences from Tatoeba (tatoeba.org, CC BY 2.0 FR) and from the library's public-domain books.

exercises.why: **вылетает** — present tense (3rd person singular) of вылетать: imperfective (perfective partner: вылететь).  Prefix **вы-**: movement out of something across a threshold, exiting (из / с / от + gen.; в / на + acc.; к + dat).
**влезает** — present tense (3rd person singular) of влезать: imperfective (perfective partner: влезть).  Prefix **в-, во-**: movement inwards across a threshold, entering (в / на + acc).
exercises.prompt: This doesn't fit in the box.

exercises.why: **выбежал** — past tense (masculine) of выбежать: perfective (imperfective partner: выбегать).  Prefix **вы-**: movement out of something across a threshold, exiting (из / с / от + gen.; в / на + acc.; к + dat).
exercises.prompt: Tom ran out of the classroom.

exercises.why: **влетела** — past tense (feminine) of влететь: perfective (imperfective partner: влетать).  Prefix **в-, во-**: movement inwards across a threshold, entering (в / на + acc).
exercises.prompt: A fly got into the apartment.

exercises.why: **выноси** — imperative (ты, singular) of выносить: imperfective (perfective partner: вынести).  Prefix **вы-**: movement out of something across a threshold, exiting (из / с / от + gen.; в / на + acc.; к + dat).
exercises.prompt: Don't wash your dirty linen in public.

exercises.why: **выносите** — present tense (2nd person plural) of выносить: imperfective (perfective partner: вынести).  Prefix **вы-**: movement out of something across a threshold, exiting (из / с / от + gen.; в / на + acc.; к + dat).
exercises.prompt: Do not wash your dirty linen in public.

exercises.why: **выбежали** — past tense (plural) of выбежать: perfective (imperfective partner: выбегать).  Prefix **вы-**: movement out of something across a threshold, exiting (из / с / от + gen.; в / на + acc.; к + dat).
exercises.prompt: Everybody ran out into the hall.

exercises.why: **внеси** — imperative (ты, singular) of внести: perfective (imperfective partner: вносить).  Prefix **в-, во-**: movement inwards across a threshold, entering (в / на + acc).
exercises.prompt: Add my name to the list.

exercises.why: **вбежала** — past tense (feminine) of вбежать: perfective (imperfective partner: вбегать).  Prefix **в-, во-**: movement inwards across a threshold, entering (в / на + acc).
exercises.prompt: A mouse came into the room.

exercises.q: Tom has never travelled outside the confines of Minnesota.
exercises.why: **выезжал** — past tense (masculine) of выезжать: imperfective (perfective partner: выехать).  Prefix **вы-**: movement out of something across a threshold, exiting (из / с / от + gen.; в / на + acc.; к + dat).
exercises.ru: Том никогда не ___ за пределы Миннесоты.

exercises.why: **вышло** — past tense (neuter) of выйти: perfective (imperfective partner: выходить).  Prefix **вы-**: movement out of something across a threshold, exiting (из / с / от + gen.; в / на + acc.; к + dat).
exercises.prompt: The sun came out from behind the clouds.

exercises.why: **вывел** — past tense (masculine) of вывести: perfective (imperfective partner: выводить).  Prefix **вы-**: movement out of something across a threshold, exiting (из / с / от + gen.; в / на + acc.; к + dat).
exercises.prompt: You have caused me to lose my temper.

exercises.why: **выбегает** — present tense (3rd person singular) of выбегать: imperfective (perfective partner: выбежать).  Prefix **вы-**: movement out of something across a threshold, exiting (из / с / от + gen.; в / на + acc.; к + dat).
exercises.prompt: The dog runs out of the house.

exercises.why: **вводит** — present tense (3rd person singular) of вводить: imperfective (perfective partner: ввести).  Prefix **в-, во-**: movement inwards across a threshold, entering (в / на + acc).

**выводи** — imperative (ты, singular) of выводить: imperfective (perfective partner: вывести).  Prefix **вы-**: movement out of something across a threshold, exiting (из / с / от + gen.; в / на + acc.; к + dat).
**вошли** — past tense (plural) of войти: perfective (imperfective partner: входить).  Prefix **в-, во-**: movement inwards across a threshold, entering (в / на + acc).
exercises.prompt: We made it to the top three.

exercises.q: Ты ещё не ___ (влезть / влезать) в долги?
exercises.why: **влез** — past tense (masculine) of влезть: perfective (imperfective partner: влезать).  Prefix **в-, во-**: movement inwards across a threshold, entering (в / на + acc).
**влез** — past tense (masculine) of влезть: perfective (imperfective partner: влезать).  Prefix **в-, во-**: movement inwards across a threshold, entering (в / на + acc).

**вылетит** — future tense (3rd person singular) of вылететь: perfective (imperfective partner: вылетать).  Prefix **вы-**: movement out of something across a threshold, exiting (из / с / от + gen.; в / на + acc.; к + dat).
exercises.prompt: That plane will take off at five.

exercises.prompt: I am losing my patience with you.
